title: Christmas Gift for Jesus Offering
description: On December 20th, we will receive a special second offering as our Christmas gift to Jesus. The offering will go toward replacing our church carpet, which is original to the building and nearly 31 years old. Our goal is to raise at least $5000, with an ultimate goal of $12000 to replace the carpet throughout the entire building. Thank you for prayerfully considering how you can help us care for God's house this Christmas season.
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
